summary: Marti Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 29, 2026, providing an update on its ongoing share repurchase program first initiated on January 10, 2024. The program authorizes repurchases of up to $2.5 million of MRT ordinary shares, subject to a ceiling price of $6.00 per share. As of the update, the company has repurchased 274,200 shares at an average price of $2.25 per share, totaling $618,296. The program is set to run through October 26, 2026. The board supports the program. No advisors are named. The repurchase is conducted in the open market. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on share price valuation.
